SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Path of Devotion mala, meditation, chanting/recitation) Sangha, Sangat). Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why is devotion important in our lives?

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. describe the elements of Bhakti Yog as per the four faiths for a deeper understanding
2. practice the elements of Bhakti Yog for spiritual growth

Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 7

Path of Devotion mala, meditation, chanting/recitation) Sangha, Sangat) helps you succeed in HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

PART 1: Describe the elements of Bhakti Yog as per the four faiths for a deeper understanding

What this means
In this part you learn to describe the elements of Bhakti Yog as per the four faiths for a deeper understanding. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: describe the elements of Bhakti Yog as per the four faiths for a deeper understanding.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Path of Devotion mala, meditation, chanting/recitation) Sangha, Sangat)” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can describe the elements of Bhakti Yog as per the four faiths for a deeper understanding. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Practice the elements of Bhakti Yog for spiritual growth

What this means
In this part you learn to practice the elements of Bhakti Yog for spiritual growth. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: practice the elements of Bhakti Yog for spiritual growth.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Story link: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Path of Devotion mala, meditation, chanting/recitation) Sangha, Sangat) in your own words.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can practice the elements of Bhakti Yog for spiritual growth. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Path of Devotion mala, meditation, chanting/recitation) Sangha, Sangat) is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Path of Devotion mala, meditation, chanting/recitation) Sangha, Sangat)” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: describe the elements of Bhakti Yog as per the four faiths for a deeper understanding)

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Path of Devotion mala, meditation, chanting/recitation) Sangha, Sangat) in your own words. (skill: practice the elements of Bhakti Yog for spiritual growth)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Path of Devotion mala, meditation, chanting/recitation) Sangha, Sangat) to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: describe the elements of Bhakti Yog as per the four faiths for a deeper understanding.
3. Practise this skill: practice the elements of Bhakti Yog for spiritual growth.
4. Make one local Kenya example of Path of Devotion mala, meditation, chanting/recitation) Sangha, Sangat) from your county, market, farm, or school.
5. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Path of Devotion mala, meditation, chanting/recitation) Sangha, Sangat): meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 7 learner study Path of Devotion mala, meditation, chanting/recitation) Sangha, Sangat)?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is devotion important in our lives?
2. How can we use the key elements of Bhakti Yog to strengthen devotion?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Path of Devotion mala, meditation, chanting/recitation) Sangha, Sangat) means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: describe the elements of Bhakti Yog as per the four faiths for a deeper understanding.
5. Be able to: practice the elements of Bhakti Yog for spiritual growth.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
